finding: PO 78214 Rev 2 is the latest authorized revision transmitted through VendorLink; Rev 1 is superseded.
Bright Meadow Foods acknowledged Rev 2 as Accepted at 13:42 on September 8, within one Northstar business day of transmission.
Net Ordered Units are 1,000: the latest authorized Rev 2 quantity is 1,000 and no eligible Northstar cancellation or later revision exists.
The shipment used Northstar-Managed Pickup under SRR-44192 and Northstar selected Granite Span Transport.
The vendor submitted a timely and complete routing request for a standard dry truckload.
The vendor credibly staged and documented 900 compliant units by the Rev 2 Ready By deadline, but did not have the remaining 100 units ready.
The Northstar-designated carrier experienced a tractor failure and arrived at origin after the vendor had timely staged the 900 tendered units.

DockSchedule recorded No Show at 11:00; HVDC Gate Arrival was 13:42 on September 17, after the scheduled appointment tolerance and destination delivery window, and all 900 presented units were accepted as compliant.
Correct On-Time Unit Rate is 90.0% (900 compliant units ready by the managed-pickup deadline divided by 1,000 Net Ordered Units), below the 98.0% PO threshold.
Correct Fill Rate is 90.0% (900 compliant units received by final close divided by 1,000 Net Ordered Units), below the 98.0% PO threshold.
Using superseded Rev 1 would cap both 900-unit numerators at 800 and falsely produce 100.0% On-Time and 100.0% Fill, changing the PO from fail to pass.
The preliminary export's 0.0% On-Time result is not the correct raw managed-pickup calculation because it uses destination arrival instead of compliant readiness.

The vendor's dispute was submitted within three business days of the affected event and is supported as to carrier-caused physical lateness, but its request to remove the whole OTIF miss is overbroad because the 100-unit vendor shortage remains.
No Logistics Manager approval or other completed PER disposition is present in the workspace.
